[00:04] Welcome to today's Tech News Podcast. I'm your host. Today, we look into Anthropic CEO's urgent call to slow down frontier AI, Sam Altman's decision to delay OpenAI's IPO over safety concerns, and a smart mechanical bench design that solves crowded transit seating.
欢迎收听今天的科技新闻播客。我是您的主持人。今天，我们将聚焦 Anthropic CEO 呼吁为前沿 AI 研发踩刹车的最新提案、OpenAI 首席执行官山姆·奥特曼因安全考量推迟 2026 年上市计划，以及一款用精巧机械结构解决车站占座痛点的公共长椅设计。

[00:23] Anthropic CEO Calls for Slowing Down Frontier AI Development. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei says it is time to slow down AI development before systems become uncontrollable. In a new proposal, he outlined a three-step plan to manage the pace of frontier model training. First, Anthropic will provide independent evaluators (评估者；评测机构) with direct access to inspect model safety. Amodei believes external safety audits are a vital unilateral (单方面的；单边的) (单方面的；单边的) move to protect society from uncontrolled risks. Second, he urges democratic nations and AI developers to establish joint safety standards and legal guardrails (防护栏；安全保障措施). Third, he hopes to bring countries like China and Russia into a global safety consensus (共识；一致意见), while maintaining Western semiconductor restrictions. Amodei warned that recursive self-improvement could soon outpace human understanding.
Anthropic 首席执行官呼吁放缓前沿 AI 研发步伐。Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫代表示，在系统彻底失控之前，现在是时候放缓人工智能的研发步伐了。在一份最新提案中，他概述了调控前沿模型训练节奏的三步走计划。首先，Anthropic 将向独立评估机构开放直接访问权限，以检验模型安全性。阿莫代认为，外部安全审计是一项保护社会免受失控风险影响的关键单边举措。其次，他敦促民主国家与 AI 开发者共同制定联合安全标准与法律防护栏。第三步，他希望推动包括中俄在内的各国达成全球安全共识，同时保持西方在半导体领域的出口管制。阿莫代警告称，递归自我改进技术可能会在不久的将来彻底超出人类的理解范围。（来源：The Verge Tech & Culture）
---
[01:11] Sam Altman Rules Out OpenAI Initial Public Offering for 2026. OpenAI chief Sam Altman confirmed that the company will not pursue an initial public offering in 2026. Speaking in a recent interview, Altman explained that going public right now would be ill-advised (不明智的；欠考虑的) given serious industry safety concerns. He openly acknowledged (承认；公认) that creating artificial intelligence beyond human control is absolutely possible. However, he promised to pause training runs whenever necessary to prevent catastrophic (灾难性的；毁灭性的) outcomes. Altman emphasized that OpenAI feels no external pressure to rush to public markets, and humanity should not be forced to take unnecessary (不必要的；多余的) risks.
山姆·奥特曼排除 OpenAI 在 2026 年进行首次公开募股的可能。OpenAI 掌门人山姆·奥特曼确认，公司不会在 2026 年寻求首次公开募股（IPO）。在最近的一次访谈中，奥特曼解释称，考虑到业内严峻的安全隐患，当前走向公开上市将是不明智的决定。他坦言，创造出超出人类控制的人工智能绝对是有可能的。然而，他承诺在必要时会直接暂停训练，以防止灾难性后果的发生。奥特曼强调，OpenAI 没有面临仓促上市的外部压力，绝不应让人类承担不必要的巨大风险。（来源：The Verge Tech & Culture）

[01:56] London Studio Designs Modular Public Bench with Rotating Seats. London design studio Of My Imagination has unveiled Flip, a modular seating system for public spaces. Commuters (通勤者；经常往返人员) frequently encounter transit benches blocked by bulky luggage and backpacks instead of people. Flip solves this frustration (令人沮丧之事；挫败感) with independent seats that flip up through a mechanical (机械的；机械学的) hinge. Rather than relying on fragile electronics or smart sensors, the bench uses a simple mechanical latch that stays functional (功能正常的；实用的) during power failures. When flipped out of the way, each section provides open floor space for strollers, heavy suitcases, or standing room during peak rush hours.
伦敦设计工作室打造单座可旋转的模块化公共长椅。伦敦设计工作室 Of My Imagination 推出了一款名为 Flip 的公共空间模块化座椅系统。通勤旅客经常会在交通枢纽中遇到长椅被笨重行李和背包占据的情况。Flip 通过机械铰链实现每个座椅的独立翻折，完美解决了这一困扰。该长椅没有依赖脆弱的电子元件或智能传感器，而是采用纯机械锁扣，即便在断电情况下也能保持正常运作。在翻折收起后，每个单元都能释放地面空间，方便放置婴儿推车、大件行李，或在早晚高峰期提供更宽敞的站立区域。（来源：Yanko Design）
